correctness.rationale: The exact published two-gap facet description reduces reflection-invariant faces to two-element incidence orbits. A necessary-and-sufficient cyclic gap criterion gives exactly two explicit interval families; each spans a full simplex and mixed faces are forbidden by cyclic sign alternation.
